_readme: Human relevance grades per job, used to measure ranking quality.
Grade scale: 4 = strong fit, 3 = good, 2 = weak, 1 = poor, 0 = irrelevant.
These grades are PROVISIONAL - drafted by reading each resume against the job
requirements. Edit them to match your own judgement; the measured accuracy is
only as meaningful as these labels.
